overview_description.description: Pirouette Pharma develops drug-device combination products that pair established injectable medicines with an auto-injector platform. The company focuses on simplifying self-injection for chronic and emergency therapies through a push-button, hidden-needle device. Its OnePush platform is designed for intramuscular and subcutaneous administration and supports use in high-stress situations and at-home care. Pirouette Pharma uses abbreviated U.S. regulatory pathways to develop improved presentations of well-characterized drugs, including a naloxone auto-injector and other chronic disease therapies. It works with pharmaceutical partners to adapt existing and novel injectables to this platform to support consistent dosing and long-term treatment adherence.
